description: This file defines a C# class DynamoDBClientOptions that encapsulates configuration options for connecting to DynamoDB storage, including credentials and region details. It includes conditional namespace directives based on compilation flags.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: A class representing configuration options for DynamoDB client, including access key, secret key, service region, token, and profile name.

methods.name: AccessKey
methods.description: Property for storing the Access Key used for DynamoDB authentication.

methods.name: SecretKey
methods.description: Property for storing the Secret Key used for DynamoDB authentication.

methods.name: Service
methods.description: Property for storing the AWS region name where DynamoDB is hosted.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Property for storing the optional token used for DynamoDB access.

methods.name: ProfileName
methods.description: Property for storing the AWS profile name for credentials.
